name: Harrower (S-Class Bloodragers Bloodline)
body:
You developed an affinity for harrow decks early in life, and the knowledge you gained shapes your magic as you grow into greater power.

Bloodline Feats Alertness, Craft Wondrous Item, Extend Spell, Fortune Teller, Harrowed, Mage’s Tattoo, Skill Focus (Knowledge [history])

Bloodline Spells ill omen (7th), augury (10th), harrowing (13th), shadow conjuration (17th)

Saving Throws

Any saving throw DCs associated with your bloodline powers are equal to 10 + 1/2 your bloodrager level + your Charisma modifier

Fuel for the Harrow (Sp)

When you cast a divination spell, you can spend 2 rounds of bloodrage per spell level to cast it instead of expending a spell slot.

Twisted Fortune (Sp)

At 4th level, you can use a standard action to cause a single target within 30 feet to become confused and unable to directly control its actions for 1 round (Will negates).

Once a creature has been affected by twisted fortune, it is immune to the ability’s effects for 24 hours.

You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Cha modifier.

See It Coming (Su)

At 8th level, you gain a +1 luck bonus on the saving throw type of your choice (Fortitude, Reflex, or Will). As a full-round action, you can change which saving throw your luck bonus applies to. At 14th level, and again at 20th level, this bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +3 at 20th level.

Invoke the Harrow (Su)

At 12th level, you can draw a random harrow card from a complete harrow deck you own as a standard action and channel the aspects of the card into your body. You take on superficial traits featured on the card and gain a +4 enhancement bonus to the ability score associated with the card’s suit.

You can invoke the harrow for a number of minutes per day equal to your bloodrager level; the duration need not be continuous, but it must be used in 1-minute increments.

Harrowed Space (Sp)

At 16th level, you can cast mage’s magnificent mansion as a spell-like ability once per day.

Kin to the Old Ways (Su)

At 20th level, while using bloodrage, you gain DR 10/cold iron and immunity to curses, paralysis, and sleep. If you can act in the surprise round of combat, you can bloodrage as a free action at the start of your turn, and you are not 4 considered flat-footed to creatures that act before you.
